image_description: A close-up, high-resolution photograph of a green common iguana (Iguana iguana) perched on a branch. The image focuses on the head, neck, and upper torso. The iguana displays vibrant green scales, a prominent dewlap under the chin, and a row of spiny scales (dorsal crest) running down the back of the neck. The eye is large with a golden iris and round pupil. The background is softly blurred, suggesting a shallow depth of field.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Head is large and triangular with a prominent dewlap (loose skin fold) hanging from the throat.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The head shape is clearly visible and triangular. The dewlap is distinct, textured, and hangs naturally from the throat area.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Eyes are large with round pupils and golden irises.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The visible eye matches the description perfectly: large, round pupil, and golden/yellowish iris. No asymmetry or distortion observed.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: A large circular subtympanic shield (scale) is present below the tympanum.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The large, circular scale characteristic of iguanas is clearly visible on the side of the head, below the ear region.
The visible portion of the torso appears thick and muscular, consistent with a robust reptile body.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Coloration is bright green in juveniles, becoming darker green to greyish-green in adults with broad black bands on the body and tail.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The iguana is predominantly bright green. While broad black bands are not fully visible in this crop, the base coloration and some darker shading on the scales match the juvenile/young adult phenotype.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Row of enlarged, spine-like scales running from the nape along the midline of the back to the tail base, forming a serrated crest.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The dorsal crest is highly prominent, starting at the nape and continuing down the neck. The spines are well-defined and structurally sound.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Skin is covered in small, granular scales with larger, plate-like scales on the head.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: Texture analysis shows fine granular scales on the body and larger, smoother plates on the snout and cheek areas. Consistent with biological reality.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Limbs are long and muscular with five clawed digits on each foot.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The limbs are partially visible but heavily occluded by the body angle and foreground elements. The digits and claws are not clearly resolvable to count or verify structure without speculation.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Tail is laterally compressed and longer than body, used for balance and defense.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The tail is mostly out of frame or obscured behind the body/branch. Cannot verify length or lateral compression.
